messages.subject: User-uploaded multiple environmental files
parts:
Hello

I am very new to Wallace... just trying it out for the first time.

I see that Wallace permits user-uploading multiple environmental files. Is it simply a matter of uploading a new file one after the other? I uploaded one and then another sequentially, but I wasn't sure if my additional upload replaced the first one or added to the first one. Is there a way to confirm this?

Thanks
Neil

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: User-uploaded multiple environmental files
parts:
Hi Neil,

Welcome to the Wallace forum! 

You need to upload all the rasters at the same time. Once you get the bar with the message "Upload complete," you can push the 'Load Env Data.' Wallace also offers guidance inside the software; you can check the Component and Module Guidance Tab. Finally, if you want a little bit more info about how Wallace works, I recommend you to check a Webinar in which Jamie Kass showed a demo of the software.

If you have more questions, please let us know.

Best,
Gonzalo
